shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- lib/api.ts ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' lib/api.ts && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- applicable instructions ---\\n' && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print"
/bin/bash -c 'git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -c "git diff -- package.json && stat -c '%n %y' package-lock.json next-env.d.ts .next 2>/dev/null && sed -n '1,120p' package.json && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
@@
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
find .next -type f -print | head -20; git status --short"
/bin/bash -c 'find .next -depth -type f -delete && find .next -depth -type d -empty -delete && git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Delete File: next-env.d.ts
*** End Patch
PATCH

git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json"
